excerpt: Lamine Cissokho is a Senegalese kora player and backing vocalist from Casamance. He comes from a griot family whose musical lineage dates to the 14th century. His father, Sana Cissokho, introduced him to the kora in childhood; his great-uncle, kora master Lalo Keba Drame, later became another key influence. Cissokho first performed traditional Manding repertoire. He later developed original compositions that connect Manding tradition with jazz, Middle Eastern music, and Nordic folk. Between 2011
_cn_summary: 兰明·西索科出身塞内加尔卡萨芒斯的十四世纪贵族格里奥特家族，自幼随父萨纳·西索科及叔公、科拉大师拉洛·克巴·德拉姆学习传统马林迪科拉，后将根源曲目与爵士即兴、阿拉伯四度音程以及北欧民谣的空灵和声交织，形成跨越非洲、亚洲与北欧的复合音景；专辑中科拉的高速弹拨与低音即兴对话、细腻的微音程滑音与木笛的呼应尤为抢耳。整体兼具古乐叙事性和当代跨界创意，是探索传统科拉在现代全球音乐语境下可能性的佳作。

album: Mimika Orchestra Completes Album Trilogy With Medzotermina
excerpt: Mimika Orchestra – Medzotermina (Menart, 2025) Mimika Orchestra has released Medzotermina, its fifth studio album. The 20-piece ensemble, conducted by composer Mak Murtić, recorded most of the nine-track album at Vatroslav Lisinski Concert Hall. Founded in London in 2010 and later based in Zagreb, Croatia, Mimika Orchestra amalgamates world music traditions with contemporary jazz. Medzotermina convinces with its mix of elegant folk-rooted vocals, powerful ensemble horns and virtuosic solos. The
_cn_summary: Mimika Orchestra 成立于伦敦，2010 年后迁至克罗地亚萨格勒布，由作曲家 Mak Murtić 指挥，是一支融合世界音乐传统与当代爵士的 20 人编制乐团。第九张专辑《Medzotermina》在瓦特罗斯拉夫·利辛斯基音乐厅录制，九首曲目以精致民谣声线、雄厚合奏铜管与技巧精湛的独奏为核心亮点，呈现出民间旋律与现代即兴的巧妙交织。整张专辑以层次分明的编曲和大胆的音色对比，在优雅与力量之间取得平衡，值得在跨界音乐场景中重点关注。

album: Oki Kano Brings Ainu Music and Dub Fusion Back To Japan Society
excerpt: Ainu musician Oki Kano will return to Japan Society for a one-night concert with Oki Dub Ainu Band. The group is known for a fusion of reggae, African rhythms, electronic dub, and Ainu folk music. At the center of Kano’s work is the tonkori, a five-string instrument from Ainu tradition in northern Japan. After decades of decline in tonkori performance, Kano helped revive the instrument through research, collaboration with Indigenous practitioners, and new compositions. The concert will mark the
_cn_summary: 阿伊努族音乐家Oki Kano凭借对失落五弦弹拨乐器——tonkori的学术研究与跨部族合作，将其重新搬上舞台，成为当代阿伊努音乐的复兴者。Oki Dub Ainu Band的专辑将雷鬼、非洲节奏与电子dub等多元风格深度融合，tonkori明亮的弹拨音色在低频贝斯、电子回声和鼓点的交错中形成独特的律动感。值得关注的亮点在于其将传统阿伊努民谣根基与全球化的dub音景相结合，既呈现文化传承，又提供耳目一新的听觉冲击。

album: Suntou Susso Earns Top Honor in ISC World Category
excerpt: (headline image: Suntou Susso, courtesy of Suntou Susso) Suntou Susso won first place in the World category at the International Songwriting Competition for “Yirolu Bala,” a composition that blends kora, chamber strings, and percussion. Susso, who lives in Nottingham, received the award as part of the competition’s latest winners announcement. Second place went to Fakahany of Cairo for the song “Ween Yaba.” Meanwhile, third place went to Haitian songwriters Daniel Prophete, Kenny Paul, and Regin
_cn_summary: 塞恩图·苏索（Suntou Susso）是一位定居于英国诺丁汉、擅长将西非传统乐器与古典弦乐相结合的多乐器演奏家，其获奖作品《Yirolu Bala》以科拉琴的弹拨为根基，交织室內弦乐与打击乐，营造出层次丰富且具仪式感的当代世界音乐声场。该曲目在国际歌曲创作大赛（ISC）世界类别中夺得第一名，凭借跨文化的音色融合与细腻的编曲张力，凸显出传统非洲节奏与西方古典编曲的大胆对话，值得关注。

excerpt: Paranormal Awakening is a moody & often seared blend of blues-tinged psych rock freakouts, off-kilter to cinematic soundtracking, and atmospheric noise. This project brings together Mitsuru Tabata (The Boredoms) and Tungu, a Ukrainian experimental electronica project.
_cn_summary: 这张专辑由日本噪音摇滚老将、Mitsuru Tabata（The Boredoms）与乌克兰实验电子组合Tungu共同打造，融合了蓝调色彩的迷幻摇滚狂飙、奇异且具电影感的配乐以及层层叠加的氛围噪音。作品以阴暗情绪为基调，扭曲的吉他呼啸与电子纹理交错出现，突显出两者在噪音与电子之间的跨界碰撞。整张专辑在失控的摇滚即兴与细腻的声场营造之间游走，值得关注的是其将实验摇滚的粗粝感与电子氛围的宏大叙事完美结合。

excerpt: Originally released in 2009, Capri features the prolific act when it was a duo, before Danielle Baquet-Long tragically passed later that year. Light drones create ambient vignettes of nature's ephemeral moments, what we take in daily, not realizing that their impermanence forms the solid foundations of our being.
_cn_summary: Celer在2009年发行《Capri》时正值Celer与Danielle Baquet‑Long的双人组合阶段，这是两人合作期间发行的唯一专辑，Danielle同年不幸逝世，使该作带有强烈的纪念色彩。整张专辑以轻盈的无人机为核心，辅以细腻的自然采样，营造出光影掠过水面般短暂却余韵悠长的氛围，声场透明、延音绵长。声音呈现出淡雅的哀愁与静谧，柔软的延音与高频颤动交织，既捕捉日常瞬息，又引发对时间流逝的沉思，极具情感张力与历史意义。

album: IT'S NICE TO SEE A LAKE IN YOUR EYES
excerpt: The debut partnership of Carol Maia and Jeremy Gustin has delivered an album of rare alchemy. With thousands of miles between Carol's home in Rio de Janeiro and Jeremy's in Brooklyn and with the help of a few friends from their respective cities they have created a record that is intimate, quietly funky and transcendental in its poetic beauty.
_cn_summary: Carol Maia是里约的歌手兼词曲创作人，Jeremy Gustin是常驻纽约布鲁克林的打击乐手兼制作人，二人通过远程合作并邀请各自的本地乐手加入，完成了这张首度跨界联手之作。专辑在亲密的人声与温暖的声场中植入了低调的放克节拍，辅以细腻的电子与原声编排，呈现出巴西热带气息与美国独立流行之间的诗意融合。最亮眼的听感在于其绵长的旋律线、如梦的歌词氛围以及在跨越数千英里后仍保持的高度整体感，这张兼具细腻感与 funky律动的作品值得深入聆听。

album: Nita Introduces Magma With New Single “Milagro 18:08”
excerpt: Spanish artist Nita has unveiled “Milagro 18:08,” the first preview of Magma, her upcoming debut solo album. The flamenco-infused electronic record, produced alongside Bronquio, marks a new stage for the Córdoba-born singer after years at the forefront of Fuel Fandango. Nita describes Magma as the most personal project of her career. According to the artist, the album draws from her Andalusian roots and from a deeply introspective creative process. The title references the force of magma emergin
_cn_summary: 西班牙安达卢西亚出生的尼塔（Nita）曾是 Fuel Fandango 的核心成员，此次以个人首张专辑《Magma》开启 solo 阶段。该专辑在 Bronquio 共同制作下，将弗拉明戈传统元素与电子节奏相融合，形成炽热而具仪式感的低音律动与层次丰富的合成器铺陈，尤其在先行单曲《Milagro 18:08》中表现出循环打击乐碎片与情感化声线的交织。凭借“最具个人化的项目”这一自我描述以及其对安达卢西亚根源的深层回溯，这张专辑兼具本土血液与现代电子氛围，是值得关注的亮点。

excerpt: By Ferruccio Martinotti First transitive property of the Free: if A plays with B and B plays with C, A will play with C. From which the second follows: if you liked A, you will like C. The empirical observation of the above, today starts from SML, a quintet composed of bassist Anna Butterss, Jeremiah Chiu synth, Booker Stardrum drums and Gregory Uhlmann guitar. International Anthem's debut album, Small Medium Large , released in 2024, was recorded at ETA in L.A., a venue Jeff Parker used for his
_cn_summary: Booker Stardrum 是活跃于洛杉矶实验爵士圈的核心鼓手兼作曲家，曾与安娜·巴特斯、耶利米亚·丘等组成的五人乐队 SML 合作，International Anthem 发行的新专辑《Close‑up On The Outside》延续了其即兴与电子融合的风格。整张专辑以紧密的鼓点为骨架，辅以合成器氛围层和吉他细腻纹理，营造出既有现场即兴感又具录音室精细度的听感亮点。最值得关注的是他那层次分明的节奏结构和在极简与丰盈之间的微妙平衡，使得每首曲目都像是对空间的“近距离”探索。

excerpt: Gridlock's Trace returns, and this is a classic industrial IDM release. As a reissue, there's nothing here that's reinventing the wheel in regards to production, it was released at a time where this type of sound was innovative and thriving.
_cn_summary: Gridlock 是英国 1990 年代初的工业/IDM 双人组合，以在噪声采样与复杂节奏构建上的极端实验闻名。《Trace》原版于 1996 年发行，其声音以尖锐的 glitch 颗粒、沉重的工业合成器低音以及层层叠加的碎拍节奏为特征，同时在噪声墙之间埋入细腻的 ambient 旋律，被视为 IDM 早期的里程碑。此次的 Reissue 基于原始母带进行 remaster，保留了当时的原始粗糙制作，为乐迷提供了在当代设备上聆听这段“工业电子正当时”先锋作品的机会。

excerpt: Two-CD issue of a live recording of his trio (Dave Holland, bass and Eliot Zigmund, drums) performing at the Kuumbwa Jazz Centre in Santa Cruz, California on 17 May 1987. Zev Feldman's diligent research located previously unknown recordings. These were early days for the diminutive and severely handicapped Petrucciani, but his daring, virtuosity and musical intelligence were already evident. Every track on this newly unearthed buried treasure confirms these judgments. Standards include Stella By Starlight, Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine.
_cn_summary: 这张双碟现场专辑记录了法国爵士钢琴家米歇尔·佩特鲁奇亚尼在1987年于加州圣克鲁兹的Kuumbwa Jazz Centre与低音提琴手戴夫·霍兰、鼓手艾略特·齐格蒙德合作的早期演出。佩特鲁奇亚尼虽因遗传性骨病身材矮小，却以极具冲击力的钢琴技巧、即兴的抒情与摇摆感，展现出与后来成熟期相媲美的音乐智慧。专辑收录了《Stella by Starlight》《Autumn Leaves》《My Funny Valentine》等标准曲目，音质被重新发掘的原始磁带保存得相当清晰，值得乐迷关注这场罕见的现场宝藏。

excerpt: The titles on this vinyl reissue come from the quintet's first studio date. Sweet Clifford is a contrafact of Sweet Georgia Brown, taken at a blistering tempo of 80 bpm. The easy-paced Stompin' At The Savoy, with its call and response routine, is a perfect vehicle for the group and Brown's use of sub-tone in his lower register is very impressive. The Clifford Brown-Max Roach quintet, along with Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers, really defined the hard-bop era.
_cn_summary: 这张《Brown and Roach Inc.》收录了克ifford Brown 与 Max Roach 两位硬波（hard‑bop）先驱合作的首次录音，克ifford Brown 以炫技式的号角和细腻的低音 sub‑tone 为主，鼓手 Max Roach 则以精准的切分节奏驱动全队。专辑核心曲目《Sweet Clifford》以极快的 80 BPM 演绎《Sweet Georgia Brown》的 contrafact，展现炽热的即兴热情；《Stompin' at the Savoy》采用轻松的拍子与呼应式编排，凸显乐团浑然天成的群奏默契。整体以坚定的硬波节拍、强劲的萨克斯与号角交织为标志，标志着该组合与 Art Blakey 的 Jazz Messengers 并列为硬波时代的定义性声音。

excerpt: Vienna-born but London-based saxophonist Guido Spannocchi rethinks the chamber music of his childhood through a clever jazzy lens. The pieces on here have a contemporary feel. Songs like DKT exhibit vibraphone to add a glimmering effect. It moves the atmosphere to a 1950s or 60s era, similar to Henry Mancini's material. Other tracks, such as Kivu, match a klezmer chamber-sound with jazz saxophone. Spannocchi has a decidedly European perspective with Yiddish influence.
_cn_summary: 出生于维也纳、现居伦敦的萨克斯手Guido Spannocchi把传统室内乐用爵士视角重新诠释，《Kammermusik》在当代感中带有复古氛围。歌曲《DKT》加入颤音琴点缀，呈现类似亨利·曼奇尼式的50‑60年代光泽；《Kivu》则把克莱兹默室内乐音型与爵士萨克斯相融合，贯穿意第绪音乐的欧陆情怀，形成跨风格的独特对话。

excerpt: US field recordist, DJ and composer Jake Muir transforms metal's quieter moments into striking evocations of place. Pareidolia is assembled from roughly 200 samples of the ambient-leaning sections of death and black metal records.
_cn_summary: Jake Muir 是一位美国现场录音师、DJ 与作曲家，他利用金属乐的静音段落进行采样，将金属的“安静时刻”重新塑造为富有场所感的声景。专辑《Pareidolia》从约 200 个死亡/黑金属唱片的氛围化片段中抽取素材，拼贴出细腻的音场、细腻的金属纹理与自然环境的呼应。其听感以寂静、层次分明的声波为主，偶尔点缀金属的嘶哑与回响，呈现出类似“金属氛围声场实验”的独特聆听体验，值得关注的是它把金属的原始冲击转化为沉思式的音景，开辟了金属采样与现场录音的全新交叉点。

album: Gipsy Kings Featuring Tonino Baliardo Launch Exhuberant New Album Historia
excerpt: Gipsy Kings Featuring Tonino Baliardo – Historia (Cooking Vinyl, 2026) Gipsy Kings Featuring Tonino Baliardo will release Historia on May 29, 2026. Led by the single “Señorita,” the accessible album will be available nearly four decades after the group’s 1987 self-titled breakthrough. That release helped bring non-English-language music to wider UK and US audiences, followed by albums such as Mosaïque and Este Mundo. “Señorita” hooks you in with Baliardo’s flamenco guitar, velvet baritone vocals
_cn_summary: Gipsy Kings是一支由法裔西班牙血统的吉他手家族组成、以弗拉明戈‑流行融合见长的乐队，Tonino Baliardo在2026年新专辑《Historia》中再度领衔，贡献标志性的弗拉明戈扫弦和柔润男中音。主打曲《Señorita》以明快的伦巴节奏、层次分明的吉他独奏以及温暖的人声为亮点，整体在保留传统西班牙吉他音色的同时采用现代录音工艺，既让四十年老乐迷重温经典，又为新听眾提供易于上手的亲和感。

album: Naragonia Quartet’s Nehalennia Evoke Village Halls and Coastal Air
excerpt: Naragonia Quartet – Nehalennia (Trad Records, 2025) Naragonia Quartet’s Nehalennia is a finely constructed chamber-folk album with a strong sense of memory and motion. Named for an ancient goddess once venerated around the North Sea, it feels enveloped in tidal history: Flemish dance traditions, Irish folk colors, and western classical poise meet with graceful confidence. “Limosa” opens with buoyant, toe-tapping energy and accordion exchanges carrying a lively communal feel. By contrast, “Nehale
_cn_summary: 这张专辑由来自比利时/荷兰的四人民乐组合Naragonia Quartet呈现，擅长把弗兰德斯传统舞曲、爱尔兰民乐色彩与西方古典室内乐手法相融合，形成了兼具民俗活力与古典庄重感的独特声音。作品以古代海神Nehalennia为主题，以手风琴、弦乐、木管等交织的音色营造潮汐般的律动，尤其在开篇曲目“Limosa”中表现出轻快的 communal feel 与交替对话的活力。值得注意的还有其对地方历史与海岸氛围的细腻描绘，使整张专辑兼具乡土气息与仪式感，是2025年传统音乐现场中不容错过的新作。

album: Seu Jorge Revisits Brazil’s Musical Soul With Majestic Precision
excerpt: Seu Jorge – The Other Side (Amor in Sound, 2026) Sixteen years after its inception, Seu Jorge presents The Other Side as an invitation into some of the most captivating styles of Brazilian music, MPB, jazz, samba and bossa nova. It is also a deeply personal statement from Seu Jorge. Jorge treats Brazilian musical tradition with reverence, passion and restless curiosity. Masterfully produced by Mario Caldato Jr. and beautifully orchestrated by composer and multi-instrumentalist Miguel Atwood-Ferg
_cn_summary: 塞乌·豪尔赫是巴西里约出身的歌手兼演员，以将波萨诺瓦、MPB与葡萄牙语摇滚相融合的作品闻名，时隔16年推出的《The Other Side》将MPB、爵士、桑巴、波萨诺瓦等巴西传统音素交织，由Mario Caldato Jr.精心制作，Miguel Atwood‑Ferg的多乐器编排与弦乐层层铺陈，营造出既温暖怀旧又充满现代感的聆听体验，值得关注的是其在致敬巴西音乐遗产的同时，以个人情感驱动的大胆编曲和细腻声线。

album: Cocanha Push Occitan Folk Into New Territory with “Flame Folclòre”
excerpt: French duo Cocanha have released “Flame Folclòre,” the title track and final single from their upcoming third album, Flame Folclòre. Notably, this is the first time Caroline Dufau and Lila Fraysse have written original material instead of primarily adapting traditional Occitan songs. Formed in Toulouse in 2014, Cocanha reinterpret folk traditions from Gascony, Languedoc, and the Pyrenees through polyphonic vocals and percussion performed in Occitan. The new album also incorporates contemporary p
_cn_summary: 法国双人组合Cocanha于2014年在图卢兹成立，以奥克语进行多声部合唱并使用打击乐再现加斯科尼、朗格多克和比利牛斯地区的传统民歌。他们的第三张专辑《Flame Folclòre》首次以原创词曲为主，在保留古老旋律的基础上融入当代流行/电子编排，使奥克民谣呈现出鲜明的现代感与层次感；同名主打曲《Flame Folclòre》将传统即兴演唱与时尚节奏巧妙碰撞，形成极具冲击力的听感，值得重点关注。

album: Berima Amo Revisits Highlife Traditions on New Single “Yaba (We Are Here)”
excerpt: Trumpeter Berima Amo has released “Yaba (We Are Here),” a new single that combines contemporary Ghanaian highlife with elements of soul music. The track centers on resilience, renewal, and perseverance in the face of hardship. The song features vocalist Tallulah Rose. “Yaba” is the second of two singles from Berima Amo’s upcoming album Rhythms of Love, scheduled for release on May 22nd 2026. Author: World Music Central News Room World music news from the editors at World Music Central
_cn_summary: 加纳小号手Berima Amo擅长把当代加纳highlife与灵魂乐融合，这次发行的单曲《Yaba (We Are Here)》以坚韧与复苏为主题，邀请歌手Tallulah Rose合作，呈现出温暖人声与活力节奏的交织。作为即将于2026年5月22日发行的专辑《Rhythms of Love》第二支先行曲目，它在保持传统highlife吉他‑打击乐结构的同时，融入了灵魂乐的柔美和声，值得关注。

album: Lucy Woodward Releases New Single, “Always” a Meditation on Connection
excerpt: English-American singer-songwriter Lucy Woodward has released a single titled “Always” on the GroundUP label. “Always,” a bluesy Americana song, is presented as a meditation on connection that endures across time, distance, and change. These persistent bonds root us to the world and to the lives we’ve lived, guaranteeing that “we will be always,” leaving traces that echo in the earth long after we’re gone. The song includes Lucy’s friend, American singer-songwriter Chris Pierce on backing vocals
_cn_summary: Lucy Woodward是一位兼具英美血统的歌手兼词曲作者，曾在流行与摇滚领域活跃多年；在GroundUP发行的单曲《Always》中，她以蓝调与阿美莉亚风格交织的吉他声线和略带沙哑的嗓音，表达“跨越时空的连结”这一沉思主题。歌词以“我们永远是回响在大地上的痕迹”为意象，呈现持久羁绊的哲思，并邀请美国歌手Chris Pierce献上和声，增添情感层次。该曲以简约编曲保留了蓝调的即兴感与民谣的叙事力度，突出温暖而略带凄美的听感。

excerpt: Humor, play, fun. These words are bandied about in the press release for The Endless Dance, a sky blue LP that sparkles like spring. The vibrant template of the cover suggests an array of flowers bursting from the earth, the artists cleverly disguised in the collage.
_cn_summary: 《The Endless Dance》是爱尔兰氛围电子作曲家Hannah Peel与中国打击乐演奏家王贝贝的首张合作专辑，Peel 以细腻的模拟合成器和声层构建梦幻氛围，贝贝 则将中国传统打击技巧与现代即兴节奏交织。整张唱片以明亮的春季氛围为基调，融合电子舞曲的轻快律动、复古合成器的闪亮音色与贝贝 多变的马林巴、铁琴敲击线条，呈现出既俏皮又具仪式感的听感。最值得注意之处在于两者在声场与节奏之间的“无限对话”，通过层叠的合成声幕与多节奏打击形成鲜明对比，使音乐在活泼的表面下暗含细腻的情感波动。

excerpt: NYC’s Relative Pitch Records put out two batches across the past two months — four albums on April 24 and four more on May 22, 2026. All are available on Bandcamp. May 22, 2026 Marta Warelis — Still Life with Lemons (RPR1258) — Live recording of the first performance of Warelis’s “Reflex” commission from Amsterdam’s […]
_cn_summary: 《Still Life with Lemons》是荷兰钢琴家兼作曲家Marta Warelis的首张现场录音，记录了她受阿姆斯特丹委托创作的混合作曲与即兴作品《Reflex》。专辑融合细腻的钢琴旋律、低限的打击乐以及偶尔的电子处理，营造出极简而张力十足的声场，强调结构呼吸感与即兴瞬时碰撞。现场演出的自然空间感与细致音色层次是其最值得关注的听感亮点。

_cn_summary: 这张《Lonely Woman》合辑汇聚了多位活跃于欧美及亚洲爵士现场的女性萨克斯与铜管独奏家，以无伴奏形式重新诠释Ornette Coleman那首兼具悲伤、幽暗与希望的标志性作品。专辑风格介于自由即兴与古典独白之间，演奏者在极简声部中营造出深沉的孤寂感与暗流涌动的情感张力。最值得注意的亮点是每位艺术家在单独发声时仍能保持高度的表达张力，既保留了原曲的情感冲突，又加入了个人独特的呼吸、节奏与音色处理，使整张合辑在同类作品中脱颖而出。

excerpt: By Kenneth Blanchard Swiss native Sylvie Courvoisier has not escaped notice. She began her recording career in the 1994 and moved to New York four years later. Since then, judging by her faculty page at the New School College of Performing Arts, she has had no difficulties finding either work or fame. Courvoisier received numerous awards including the United States Artist Fellow (2020); the Foundation for Contemporary Arts Grants to Artists (2018); Swiss Music Prize (2018); Switzerland SUISA’s J
_cn_summary: 瑞士钢琴家西尔维·库尔瓦西耶自1994年发行首张专辑后于1998年移居纽约，曾获2020年美国艺术家奖与2018年瑞士音乐奖等殊荣。《Éclats-Live in Europe》是其三重奏的现场录音，融合了当代爵士与即兴的结构感，钢琴的抒情与鼓、低音提琴的互动产生强烈的动态张力；现场氛围让即兴段落在张力与抒情之间自由游走，突显了对和声空间的深度探索与舞台能量的即时捕捉。

excerpt: New (American) gal in town, San Francisco vocalist Noa Levy joins the trio of UK 2023 Parliamentary Award winning pianist Paul Edis with eminent reedman Alan Barnes added to three of the 10 tracks. All titles are associated with Bill Evans. The human voice (Levy's) is the central feature of this (not entirely successful) experiment. Barford and Barnes are more successful in this self-imposed task than Levy. This is an ambitious album with Edis, Barnes, King and Barford in sterling form throughout. Levy is inconsistent but also shows promise.
_cn_summary: 《Portrait In Evans》由旧金山新人歌手Noa Levy领衔，携手2023年英国议会奖获奖钢琴家Paul Edis，并邀请著名单簧管/萨克斯手Alan Barnes在数曲中助阵，专辑全十首曲目均改编自Bill Evans的作品。音乐以现代爵士为基调，人声被置于中心，钢琴与木管的即兴对话交织出层次丰富、情感细腻的声响，但在人声表现上Levy时而不稳、时有闪光，整体呈现出演绎上的雄心与实验性。尽管人声实验并非全然成功，钢琴与管乐的演绎堪称标杆，展示了乐团对Bill Evans精神的独到致敬。

excerpt: Vocalist Siril Malmedal Hauge once more joins with pianist Kjetil Mulelid on this release. The Norwegian pair have worked together, and it shows, as an old friendship shows to a stranger. Filled with originals and a few carefully chosen covers. Hauge's vocals, when a cappella, can seem a bit chilly. Mulelid's playing can be a bit dry from time to time but there are some excellent moments where his glissandos shine. The softer, moody tone they take throughout seems very Scandinavian.
_cn_summary: 《I Remember Oranges》出自挪威歌手Siril Malmedal Hauge与钢琴家Kjetil Mulelid这对老搭档，专辑收录原创曲目并点缀数首精心挑选的翻唱。整体风格柔和、带有北欧特有的忧郁氛围，旋律轻盈、结构简约，极具斯堪的纳维亚的音色特征。Hauge的无伴奏人声略显冷冽，而Mulelid的钢琴在滑音（glissando）处展现出亮眼的细腻情感，形成干练又富于情绪的听感亮点。

excerpt: Veteran French bassist Henri Texier is calling on past compositions of his to be applied as balm to brows fevered by the current anxiety-provoking atmosphere. His quintet, with guest drummer Manu Katché on three of the nine tracks, performs the music he found comforting when he wrote it. Octogenarian Texier has a style that has remained personal and consistent throughout his career. Nigel Jarrett reviewing.
_cn_summary: 法国资深低音提琴手Henri Texier已逾八旬，仍坚持其独特的爵士语汇，在这张《Healing Songs》中以五重奏形式呈现。专辑以温暖的acoustic jazz为基调，旋律悠扬、低音圆润，并在三首曲目中加入法国鼓手Manu Katché的客座演绎，营造出抚慰焦虑、疗愈心灵的声音氛围。Texier 的作曲保持个人化且连贯，强调情感的表达与音色的层次感，使《Healing Songs》成为一张兼具慰藉与深度的聆听体验，值得关注。

Metheny’s unmistakable guitar tone propels the central riff forward, while Fishman supplies sleek harmonic momentum over Dyson’s restless, bubbling drumming. _cn_summary: Pat Metheny 是拥有四十余年爵士/融合音乐经验的吉他大师，SIDE‑EYE III+ 是他“Side‑Eye”系列的第三张专辑，携低音手 Fishman 与鼓手 Dyson 组成三人编制。专辑以《It On It》开篇，凭借强劲的 riff、细腻的高保真录音与三人高度磨合的现场张力，在主题动机驱动下呈现出丰富的色块和声、流畅的调式转换以及即兴独奏与复合节奏的交织。整张唱片将摇滚的驱动力、爵士的和声深度与实验性的调式变化融为一体，Fishman 与 Dyson 在多段交叉节拍与调式转折中提供了稳固且多变的支撑，是 Metheny 近年来在声音与技术层面最值得关注的作品。

_cn_summary: 《BITCHES BLUES》是挪威吉他手 Hedvig Mollestad 主导的实验摇滚三人乐团 Hedvig Mollestad Weejuns 的第二张专辑，融合 funk、金属、蓝调并加入迷幻合成器纹理。专辑同名曲以紧凑的 funk‑metal‑blues 锐利冲击开场，《Compete Blir》转向低沉的脉冲式迷幻，随后《For a Moment I Thought I Could Hear You》以不对称、自由漂浮的结构展开，整体在粗粝吉他冲击与细腻氛围之间形成强烈对比。最值得注意的《Limite》以缓慢 rubato 铺展抑郁纹理，展现乐队对节拍与音色的精准把控，暗示现场演绎这些复杂结构时的张力。

_cn_summary: Dead Meadow 成立于1998年，源自华盛顿特区的朋克/独立现场，后迁至洛杉矶，至今已发行十张专辑。《Force Free Form》以60年代迷幻摇滚为根基，厚重法兹吉他、层叠的空间键盘与迷幻即兴交织，营造出兼具狂野与慵懒的音墙。Jason Simon（吉他/器官/合成器）与Steve Kille（贝斯）及Mark Laughlin（鼓）在节奏上的配合形成紧密的低频支撑与流畅律动，专辑的最大亮点在于厚重的回响吉他与柔和的氛围之间的强烈对比，提供沉浸式的梦游听感。

excerpt: Phillip Golub Partisan Ship An album of microtonal jazz played on a Flexichord keyboard proves anall-enveloping experience, for Andrew Taylor-Dawson Partisan Ship by Phillip Golub The word 'immersive' can be overdone or feel forced when applied to artistic endeavours, be it a theatrical performance, an exhibition or indeed an album. Yet, it feels like the natural descriptor for Partisan Ship, the latest offering from LA born, Brooklyn-based pianist, composer and bandleader Phillip Golub.
_cn_summary: 出生于洛杉矶、现居布鲁克林的全能钢琴家、作曲家兼乐队领袖Phillip Golub，在《Partisan Ship》中运用Flexichord键盘演奏微音阶爵士，打造层层交织、极具空间感的音色。整张专辑以微分音高与和声的细腻结构实现全沉浸式聆听体验，展现了Golub在微观音高与音色探索上的前沿实践。

The trac
_cn_summary: Bryan Sutton是美国蓝草吉他手，以Flatpicking技巧和多次格莱美提名闻名；Tommy Emmanuel是澳洲指弹吉他大师，以爵士、摇摆风格的自创指弹技巧著称。两人的合作《Don’t Let Your Deal Go Down》把传统蓝草旋律与爵士/摇摆的和弦进行相结合，Sutton的快速拨弦与Emmanuel的指弹声部交叉呼应，产生层次感强、节奏活泼的即兴对话。此曲在保持蓝草根基的同时，展示了跨风格的即兴装饰与律动，是从Roots To Branches系列中最具创意融合度的作品。

The title Buin translates as “belong.” However, related Gaelic words such as buain (“harvest”) and buan (“long-lasting”) also reflect the album’s themes. _cn_summary: 《Buin》是苏格兰手风琴演奏家、跨界作曲家 Pàdruig Morrison 的首张个人专辑，收录原创器乐曲目与四首全新创作的盖尔语歌曲，兼具传统盖尔民谣旋律与当代作曲手法。专辑以手风琴为主线声部，配合弦乐、木管等编配，营造出温暖而带有北苏格兰荒野感的音色；盖尔语歌词围绕“归属”主题，探索与土地、社区、文化的情感联结。最值得注意的亮点在于器乐与声乐的平衡、对“归属”概念的多元阐释，以及音乐中交织的民俗根基与现代创意，形成别具一格的世界音乐气质。

album: Fiddler Gráinne Brady Unveils Back and Forth

_cn_summary: Sam Opoku是一位在加纳裔美国人背景中成长的歌手兼词曲作者，此次凭借《Old》这首单曲在全球约13000件参赛作品中脱颖而出，夺得2025年国际作曲大赛（ISC）总榜冠军。歌曲以钢琴与轻柔的非洲打击乐交织为基底，配合温暖的人声与细腻的情感叙事，聚焦于老年、悔恨与寻找生活乐趣的主题，展现出跨越西方流行与西非旋律的独特声音。值得注意的亮点是其成熟的主题深度、层次分明的编曲以及在全球化语境中对个人记忆的精准捕捉。

excerpt: ACL readers may remember Bambi OFS (Cédric Dambrain) from the hyperkinetic EP Yakka. Since then, the Brussels artist has released the EP Kwon-9, whose remixes fleshed it out to the length of an LP, and now Minke. Should one wish, one might view these releases as a trilogy.
_cn_summary: Bambi OFS（本名Cédric Dambrain）是比利时布鲁塞尔的电子制作人，以《Yakka》EP的极快动感和碎片化合成声在圈内脱颖而出。最新全长《Minke》延续其“hyperkinetic”风格，融合工业 techno、复古 rave 的共振与厚重的低频冲击，兼具高速节拍的冲击力和细腻声部层次。相较前两部 EP，《Minke》在曲目结构和声音设计上更为系统化，展现从极速敲击到氛围铺陈的完整弧线，值得关注其在高能节奏与实验音色之间的平衡把控。

excerpt: Lost Hope Society doesn’t deal in easy optimism. Instead, it locates hope as a kind of underlying signal—constant, even when masked by noise. Like Midsommar, it uses brightness to reveal shadow, and in doing so, turns discomfort into clarity.
_cn_summary: Lost Hope Society 是一支来自瑞典的实验电子/后朋克交叉乐团，此前以阴暗氛围与低传真音色著称。专辑《The Music Liberation Front Sweden》融合了闪烁的合成器、碎片化的噪音纹理与低保真鼓点，以明亮的音色映射阴影，形成“噪声中隐匿的恒定希望”之感，最突出的听感在于极致的动态对比与层层递进的情绪结构。值得注意的还有瑞典语政治口号的采样、现场音景的运用以及嘉宾瑞典民俗乐手的点缀，使整张专辑在批判与救赎之间保持张力。

excerpt: Brian Morton's sleeve-note questions whether Ray Charles was a jazz singer, an R&B singer or a pop singer. He was clearly all of those but several of the albums he recorded during the 50s and early 60s really established his jazz credentials. The first six titles here were arranged by Quincy Jones. With his inimitable approach as a song stylist he makes these selections all his own especially the soulful Georgia On My Mind. 20th Century Masterworks LP.
_cn_summary: 雷·查尔斯（Ray Charles）作为美国跨足灵魂、R B、爵士与流行的“天才”歌手，这张《The Genius Of Ray Charles》收录了他在上世纪50‑60 年代与昆西·琼斯（Quincy Jones）合作的早期录音，前六首曲目全部由琼斯编曲，形成兼具大乐队爵士编配与浓郁灵魂味的独特音墙。专辑以《Georgia on My Mind》等经典曲目为代表，展现查尔斯标志性的即兴唱腔、情感张力以及对和声的细腻处理，凸显其在爵士乐领域的深厚功底与跨风格影响力。

excerpt: In a musical landscape where virtually every new title promoted as 'jazz' would be unrecognizable to the musicians who actually created it, circa 1895, in New Orleans, it's refreshing to encounter a new release that not only acknowledges those pioneers but also respects and honours them, and one in particular, George Lewis. Leon Nock reviewing.
_cn_summary: Alyn Shipton 是英国低音提琴手、爵士史学者并主持 BBC 节目，他的 New Orleans Friends 组合在牛津现场录制本专辑，专注于复刻 19 世纪末至 20 世纪初的新奥尔良早期爵士，尤其向传奇长号手 George Lewis 致敬。专辑采用传统原声编制——短号、长号、单簧管、低音提琴、钢琴与鼓，呈现浓郁的多声部即兴合奏与强劲的切分节奏，保留了那段时期音色的温暖与活力。现场录音捕捉了牛津音乐厅的自然混响，使空间感与层次感格外突出，值得关注之处在于其严谨的音乐史研究与对早期曲目的精准还原。

excerpt: During the 1970s French singer and entertainer Sacha Distel performed a number of times at the London Palladium and on British TV, and on these visits he would drop into Collets Jazz Shop. This album from 1956 was issued originally on Atlantic. Matthew Wright reviewing.
_cn_summary: 这张《Afternoon In Paris》是美国爵士钢琴家John Lewis与法国歌手兼吉他手Sacha Distel于1956年在Atlantic合作发行的专辑，以冷爵士钢琴为基调，辅以Distel柔美的法语歌声和吉他点缀，营造出巴黎咖啡厅的悠闲氛围。专辑融合了现代爵士的严谨结构和法式香颂的浪漫情调，旋律简洁、节奏轻盈，是早期跨大西洋爵士合作的亮点。重新发行后在音响恢复上表现出色，值得乐迷关注其历史价值与音乐品质。

excerpt: Visible Cloaks Paradessence Portland, Oregon duo amplify the creaks and cracks between the many different styles in their toolbox Paradessence by Visible Cloaks Paradessence spotlights the innate surrealism of Visible Cloaks shimmering, digital-powered exotica.
_cn_summary: Visible Cloaks 是来自美国俄勒冈州波特兰的氛围电子双人组合，擅长以极简合成、采样与自然声纹交织出细腻的声景；《Paradessence》在此基础上将数字化的异域音调与碎裂的细微裂纹融合，营造出如幻似真的光泽声场，突出其超现实的沉浸感与电子、仪式化节拍之间的微妙平衡。

excerpt: Seefeel Sol.Hz Five years on from their EP, London's Seefeel continue to plough that fertile furrow between ambient shimmer, dub oomph and the silences in-between Sol.Hz by Seefeel The cover of Seefeel's latest album Sol.Hz seems to stare back at you.
_cn_summary: Seefeel 是一支源自伦敦的老牌实验氛围乐队，自1990年代起凭借吉他循环与空灵声场奠定独特风格。相隔五年后推出的全长专辑《Sol.Hz》继续融合 ambient shimmer、dub‑type 低频冲击与细腻的静音层叠，营造出漂浮感与重量感并存的听感结构。专辑的亮点在于其空间感极强的声场布局和极具辨识度的低沉律动，值得在高质量耳机或音箱下细细品味细节变化。

excerpt: Afro-Cuban rhythms, no-wave garage punk edge, homemade funk and a fearless middle-fingered attitude towards generic straightforwardness. It's also fun, surreal, irreverent and ace.
_cn_summary: Charlie Chimi 是一位在地下音乐场景中活跃的跨流派创作者，其新作《DISCO CHIMI》把 Afro‑Cuban 节奏与 no‑wave 车库朋克的粗糙锋芒、自制 funk 混为一体，整体呈现出对平淡直白音乐的反叛姿态。专辑在狂野的节拍与荒诞幽默之间游走，律动感强烈且充满不羁的反讽情绪，值得在独立音乐爱好者和跨文化实验中关注。

album: A Guide to WRWTFWW, Switzerland’s Maverick Indie Label
excerpt: The label's offerings include video game soundtracks to experimental ambient, bespoke pressings, and more. Read full story on the Bandcamp Daily .
_cn_summary: WRWTFWW是一家总部位于瑞士的独立厂牌，旗下艺人主要来自独立游戏与电子音乐跨界创作领域，专注于将像素时代的芯片音乐与现代环境音融合。专辑收录了从复古像素音效到沉浸式氛围音色的多样化作品，节奏层次丰富、纹理细腻，兼具怀旧感与前沿实验性。每首曲目都与特定游戏情境或视觉概念紧密相连，配合手工限量的黑胶包装，突显厂牌对声音与实体双重收藏价值的执着。

excerpt: Part of a combined review with Siril Malmedal Hauge & Kjetil Mulelid and Guido Spannocchi. Konstantin N. Rega reviewing.
_cn_summary: Anton Toorell 是一位挪威的青年钢琴演奏家兼作曲家，常在北欧即兴与后古典交叉领域活跃，曾参与多支爵士与当代音乐团体的演出。其作品《Solos II》延续了他标志性的独奏系列，以纯钢琴独奏为核心，融合北欧民谣的抒情旋律与后现代古典和声结构，并巧妙运用轻度的预制钢琴技术与细腻的空间混响，形成兼具弹性质感与柔软余韵的听感。该专辑最值得关注之处在于 Toorell 对音符间精准留白和音色微雕的掌控，使每首曲目都呈现出极简框架下的情绪微电影，值得乐迷与评论家关注。

excerpt: Part of a combined review with John Lewis & Sacha Distel: Afternoon In Paris and Melissa Aldana: Filin. Matthew Wright reviewing.
_cn_summary:
McCoy Tyner 作为 John Coltrane 四重奏核心成员，凭借标志性的左手指法和强烈的和声冲击，重新定义了现代爵士钢琴的声响。  
《The Seeker》以六重奏编制呈现，融合后波普、modal jazz 与非洲/拉丁节拍，既保留硬波的硬朗节奏，也展示抒情旋律与细腻的和声层次。  
整张专辑突出 Tyner 在高速即兴与低音冲击之间的张力切换，乐队紧凑的对话与曲目结构的大胆探索成为值得注意的亮点。

album: New Orleans Jazz and Heritage Festival 2026
excerpt: The New Orleans Jazz and Heritage Festival, now in its 55th year, increasingly looks like a major rock and pop festival, with a series of niche festivals running alongside the headline acts. The conundrum with the ongoing moniker of Jazz Fest is that to sustain a profitable festival, the vast majority of festival-goers attend for the non-jazz acts. Live review from Jazz Journal.
_cn_summary: 第55届新奥尔良爵士与文化遗产节（2026）以本土传奇爵士、布鲁斯、灵魂乐艺术家以及当红摇滚、流行明星的混搭阵容呈现，显示出 festival 从传统爵士向大众流行转型的趋势。整体声音在保留新奥尔良特有的即兴爵士、蓝调和 funk 律动的基础上，融入摇滚、电子等元素，使现场既有地道本土氛围，又具备商业化的大众共鸣。值得注意的亮点包括主舞台之外的 niche 主题音乐节和跨界合作，以及因大多数观众因非爵士表演而来所引发的“ Jazz Fest ”名实不符的商业考量。

album: In the Shadow of the Bomb: Heavy Water
excerpt: Magic Tuber Stringband's first LP as a trio is a work of unruly beauty that doubles as a cautionary tale, says Bernie Brooks Magic Tuber Stringband by Dani Smith Probably it's best to start with Ellenton, South Carolina.
_cn_summary: Magic Tuber Stringband是一支来自南卡罗来纳州埃勒顿的本土民间乐队，此次《In the Shadow of the Bomb: Heavy Water》为首张以三重奏形式发行的全长专辑，突显其从传统 Appalachia 民谣到迷幻实验的自由跨越。专辑以粗犷的原声吉他、层叠的口琴和低沉的敲击声交织出“狂野之美”，并在每首曲目的即兴段落中埋入对现代危机的警示隐喻。整体听感兼具紧张的张力与原始的现场感，特别是专辑的标题曲和结尾段的声波冲击，令人感受到音乐与社会的双重批判。

album: Madrid’s San Isidro Festival 2026 to Celebrate Flamenco Rumba Legends and Newcomers
excerpt: Madrid’s San Isidro festivities will center on rumba flamenca, flamenco, and popular Spanish sounds this week through a concert series organized by the city’s Department of Culture, Tourism, and Sports. The program features performances by Las Ketchup, Los Chunguitos, Las Migas, and Montoya & Carmona, alongside sets from Manuel Malou, Demarco Flamenco, and DJ Pablo Pueblo. The main celebrations will take place at Pradera de San Isidro public park, where DJ Pablo Pueblo will open the evening at 2
_cn_summary: 2026年马德里圣伊西德罗节将rumba flamenco与当代西班牙流行声音融合，演出阵容包括80年代标志性rumba乐团Los Chunguitos、以《Ketchup Song》走红的Las Ketchup，以及以现代弗拉明戈融合见长的Montoya & Carmona等新锐。现场以吉他扫弦、手拍与电子节拍交错的方式呈现，营造出传统热情与街头电子的强烈冲击感。最值得关注的是在公共开放空间Pradera de San Isidro上演的多风格混搭：传统弗拉明戈歌手Demarco Flamenco与DJ Pablo Pueblo的现场混音，为听众提供从复古到前卫的完整聆听体验。

excerpt: Imagine living in the "best town," a rural community of friendly neighbors surrounded by natural beauty, and then having to leave it behind.
_cn_summary: Magic Tuber Stringband 是一支源自美国俄勒冈的独立民谣/古谣聚合体，成员兼具传统弦乐演奏与实验音效制作的背景，作品常以自然声景与古谣手法交织。《Heavy Water》延续其标志性的班卓、曼陀林与小提琴的复合编排，但在编曲上加入了大量空间混响与环境音采样，使音乐既保留乡村弦乐的粗粝质感，又呈现如梦境般的氛围。专辑围绕“最美小镇”的生活与离去展开叙事，旋律中蕴含的怀旧与失落感通过柔和的和声与层次丰富的音墙表现出来，突出其在传统民谣根基上进行的诗意实验。

excerpt: Experimental club music, funk, and more. Read full story on the Bandcamp Daily .
_cn_summary: 尽管该艺人的公开背景有限，但从作品的实验俱乐部与放克融合趋势可推断他深耕于地下电子音乐圈，擅长在传统舞曲框架中注入非线性实验。专辑以粗粝合成器音色、强劲放克律动和不规则节拍交织，形成冲击力强且层次丰富的声场；其中高频噪音与低频贝斯的对撞尤为亮眼，突破常规结构并提供前卫且具跳舞性的听感。此专辑最值得关注的是其将实验性与舞曲能量无缝结合的能力，适合寻找突破常规节奏体验的听众。

excerpt: Alan Myson embraces imperfection on his most introspective, human-sounding music to date. Read full story on the Bandcamp Daily .
_cn_summary: Alan Myson（艺名Ital Tek）是一位在Planet Mu、Ghostly等厂牌发表作品的英国电子/氛围老将，长期以极简碎拍和合成纹理著称。新专辑《Mind Abandon》有意接纳不完美的音色，加入钢琴、现场录音与低沉的合成旋律，营造出更具手工感、情感化的氛围，是其迄今为止最自省、最具人味的作品。该专辑以简约的节拍、悠长的音色蔓延和细腻的情感起伏为亮点，展现出从技术炫技向情绪深度转变的转向，值得乐迷关注。

excerpt: The collision of gabber, gamelan, and metal becomes something strangely transcendent on Takkak Takkak’s second album. Read full story on the Bandcamp Daily .
_cn_summary: 《Takkak Takkak》是印尼地下实验音乐人Abu（本名不详）的第二张全长，以极速gabber鼓机、刺耳金属riff以及现场录制的甘美兰金属共鸣交织，构成狂野的工业仪式感。 在极端节拍的冲击下，甘美兰的微调音阶与金属的嘶哑和声产生既原始又超现实的跨文化碰撞，使整张专辑保持层次感与仪式感。 最值得关注的是其将传统印尼仪式音色的透明感与现代硬核电子的破坏性完美融合，堪称亚洲实验电子与金属融合的前沿力作。

excerpt: The ambient country stalwarts tighten up their songwriting while simultaneously expanding their horizons. Read full story on the Bandcamp Daily .
_cn_summary: SUSS 是一支美国的氛围乡村组合，擅长以延迟吉他、pedal steel 与空灵合成器营造宽阔的声景。专辑《Counting Sunsets》在保留标志性混响氛围的同时，将歌曲结构收紧，旋律线条更突出——如《Dusty Road》以沉稳的吉他弹拨配合细腻合成垫层，《Midnight Highway》则用温暖的 pedal steel 与轻盈的电子脉冲交织，呈现出黄昏般的寂寥与宁静。整体上，这张专辑在氛围感与旋律性之间取得平衡，展示了乐队从声墙向更简洁叙事的转变，是值得关注的方向性作品。

excerpt: re[Ø]load presents a focused study in kinetic fragmentation, balancing technical finesse with a visceral, bodily pull that makes its abstract architecture unexpectedly physical.
_cn_summary: re[Ø]load EP 由独立电子制作人 Bearclaw 打造，延续其在 glitch 与 techno 交叉领域的实验精神，专辑呈现高速的节奏碎片化与层叠的合成器纹理。最具冲击力的听感在于将抽象声波结构与强劲低频驱动相结合，使抽象架构在身体层面产生强烈的脉动感。该 EP 的亮点在于短小精悍的曲目结构、精准的音色调制以及在碎拍中保持的连贯性，值得现代电子乐迷关注。

album: The Big Soul Of John Lee Hooker
excerpt: Part of a combined review of three reissues: Ray Charles: The Genius Of Ray Charles, Clifford Brown-Max Roach Quintet: Brown and Roach Inc., and John Lee Hooker: The Big Soul Of John Lee Hooker. Gordon Jack reviewing.
_cn_summary: John Lee Hooker 是出生于密西西比的传奇蓝调吉他手/歌手，在这张 1960 年代 Vee‑Jay 再版的《The Big Soul Of John Lee Hooker》中，他首度摆脱独奏蓝调，走进配有四重奏铜管、键盘与背景合唱的大编制乐团，呈现出原始吉他与灵魂乐编曲的混血风格；厚重的号角编排与强劲的节奏让 Hooker 那低沉的嗓音在豪华编制中仍保持粗犷冲击力。此次再版额外收录了原版未发行的 Bonus Tracks，并进行了高质量 Remastered，让乐迷可以感受到更清晰、更有现场感的音效细节。

album: For Ev'ry Man There's A Woman
excerpt: Part of a combined review with Alyn Shipton's New Orleans Friends: The Oxford Concert. Leon Nock reviewing.
_cn_summary: Jack Wood 是一位以低沉男中音和叙事民谣见长的独立歌手，《For Ev'ry Man There's A Woman》携手由低音提琴手 Alyn Shipton 领衔的新奥尔良传统爵士乐队 New Orleans Friends，将早期美国民谣与新奥尔良铜管即兴相融合，产生兼具木管摇摆与原声吉他弹拨的混合音色。专辑在现场录音的温暖氛围中突出 Wood 略带沧桑的嗓音与乐队的轻快即兴对话，尤其《Heart of a Man》与《Streets of Soho》以锋利歌词和复古编排形成张力，凸显其在新旧风格交叉点的独特价值。

excerpt: Part of a combined review with John Lewis & Sacha Distel: Afternoon In Paris and McCoy Tyner: The Seeker. Matthew Wright reviewing. Melissa Aldana at the Newport festival in 2022.
_cn_summary: 梅丽莎·阿尔达纳是智利出生的次中音萨克斯手，凭2022年格莱美获奖专辑《Echoes》已进入当代爵士乐坛领军行列，其演奏以抒情且富有张力的音色著称。《Filin》延续她融合拉丁节奏与现代和声的现代爵士语言，四重奏编制中萨克斯与钢琴的即兴对话层次丰富，节奏组提供灵活而有力的支撑。最亮眼之处在于阿尔达纳情感丰沛的旋律线与严谨结构之间的平衡，使专辑在自由即兴与叙事性之间形成独特的听感，值得关注。

_cn_summary: 以色列裔美国单簧管演奏家Anat Cohen凭借细腻的音色与跨流派视野，在《(untitled)》中以单簧管领衔四重奏（钢琴、低音提琴、鼓），在巴西choro、北美swing与中东旋律之间自由切换，呈现温暖且层次分明的声场。专辑最亮眼的听感是即兴段落的流畅对话：单簧管的抒情即兴与钢琴的低音支撑、低音提琴的弹性铺底以及鼓点的细腻点缀相互交织，形成既具结构感又充满即兴张力的听感。Cohen将传统巴西节奏与现代爵士语汇相融合，使这张未命名作品在同场评审的Henri Texier、Mark Wade Trio与Joe Lovano作品中脱颖而出，值得关注。

_cn_summary: Mark Wade是纽约出身、以旋律即兴见长的低音提琴手/作曲家，这张未命名专辑延续其温暖而富有弹性的低音线条。七首原创曲目在钢琴与鼓的细腻配合下兼具后波普的即兴张力与现代室内乐的精致结构，节奏转折与和声展开处层次分明、流畅度高，录音采用近距离拾音保留低音温暖与鼓点真实感，在当代爵士三重奏中以细腻音场和演奏对话脱颖而出。

_cn_summary: Joe Lovano，1952年生于克利夫兰的美国萨克斯手，2014年获格莱美奖，曾与迈克·里奇、查尔斯·劳埃德等合作，以其浑厚的音色和跨风格即兴著称。\n这张《(untitled)》以现场录音、曲目无标题的形式呈现，聚焦标志性的后波普即兴并融合自由爵士的突发张力与民谣色彩的旋律，形成紧凑的三重奏/四重奏编制，节奏组在低保真环境中提供坚实且富有弹性的支撑。\n最抢眼的听感在于Lovano那尖锐而富感情的次中音萨克斯独白，在鼓点与低音提琴的紧密配合下动态起伏剧烈、情绪表达直白，因而被视为他近年来最具冲击力的现场即兴力作，值得乐迷关注。
值得关注的前卫实验音乐作品。

_cn_summary: 伊沃·佩雷尔曼是巴西出生的抒情派自由爵士萨克斯手，达蒙·史密斯则是以流动的低音提琴技法著称的美国即兴家，两人在这张《核心之存》中以萨克斯‑低音提琴二重奏展开细腻的对话。佩雷尔曼绵长的呼吸式即兴与史密斯在弓弦与拨弦之间的快速切换交织出，时而柔软如水波的光斑，时而锋利如冲击波的音色块，令专辑在冥想般的氛围中不断出现出乎意料的动态转折。专辑的亮点在于极简编制却能产生丰富的泛音层次和情感张力，呈现出对存在核心的哲学性探索。
